blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—A network of human rights groups is calling for a deeper probe by the International Criminal Court (ICC) into the atrocities in Myanmar so that it can prosecute the people responsible after a United Nations (UN) tribunal found the state guilty of genocide. To do this, the International Federation for Human Rights (FIDH) urged the United Nations Security Council (UNSC) to endorse the crimes being committed by Myanmar’s military junta against Rohingya refugees in Myanmar, which have been under investigation by ICC prosecutors, although in a limited scope, since 2019.
